notes.note: Bounded review of passkey-add session witness change in local-account-provider and local-account-passkeys. Existing authentication composition, current-session/revocation contract and separate Project authority remain accurate. Session ID stays inside the private account operation and connection-local temporary SQLite guard; no new network destination, telemetry field, public identity or storage export. Does not re-audit unrelated privacy inventory or establish live/native/physical-authenticator acceptance. Final canonical-ID review: credential INSERT guard is installed from the plugin-verified authenticator credential ID after final exact-session validation, never from client response.id/rawId. A client-ID substitution regression reproduced 200 after revocation before this refinement and now refuses; normal addition remains covered. Guard setup refuses an unrelated active SQLite transaction rather than joining its rollback. Physical/native/two-human and exhaustive concurrency schedules remain unverified. Reviewed cleanup ownership refinement: finalizer queues retirement through actual Better Auth adapter.transaction, so a foreign registration rollback cannot restore its DROP. Real provider/plugin HTTP overlap regression reproduced one orphan before fix, and 22 owner tests passed after fix. Merged main549 with both member-passkeys and progressive-tools preview bindings plus published upstream dependency updates retained; no authentication peer-policy relaxation.
